# Moul UI

> Moul UI (`@moul-dev/web-component`, v1.0.0-alpha.2) is an accessible, standards-first Web Components library built with Lit, Shadow DOM, and native CSS tokens (OKLCH + `light-dark()`). Components are framework-agnostic `<moul-*>` custom elements.

<!-- Generated by `bun run sync:llms --write` from ui/dist/custom-elements.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

## Quick Start

```bash
bun add @moul-dev/web-component
# or
npm install @moul-dev/web-component
```

```js
// Registers every <moul-*> custom element (side-effect import).
import '@moul-dev/web-component'
// CSS token layer: colors, spacing, radii, typography, motion.
import '@moul-dev/web-component/style.css'
```

Without a bundler, load the self-contained CDN build (Lit and the other dependencies inlined):

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@moul-dev/web-component/dist/assets/style.css" />
<script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@moul-dev/web-component/dist/cdn/moul-ui.js"></script>
```

`dist/moul-ui.js` (the package entry) keeps `lit`, `@lit/context`, `@lit-labs/virtualizer`, `motion`, and `d3-*` as bare imports so a bundler shares one copy of Lit with your app. Do not load it directly in a `<script>` tag.

## Core Rules for LLMs & AI Coding Agents

- **Imports**: `import '@moul-dev/web-component'` once registers every `<moul-*>` element. Import design tokens with `import '@moul-dev/web-component/style.css'`. Motion controllers and effect elements live in a second entry, `import '@moul-dev/web-component/effects'`; an app that never imports it ships none of that code. There is no `@moul-dev/web-component/react`, `@moul-dev/web-component/tokens`, or `@moul-dev/web-component/tokens.stylex` entry point.
- **Markup, not JSX components**: Write native custom element tags (`<moul-button>`), never PascalCase components (`<Button>`). They work in plain HTML, Astro, Lit, Vue, Svelte, and React 19.
- **Attributes are kebab-case**: Boolean state uses presence attributes such as `is-disabled`, `is-open`, `is-checked`, `is-required`. The matching JS property is camelCase (`el.isDisabled = true`).
- **Rich data is set as properties**: Arrays, objects, and functions (`data`, `series`, `columns`, `items`, `logs`, `valueFormatter`) are assigned in JavaScript, not serialized into attributes.
- **Events are DOM events**: Listen with `addEventListener` (`press`, `change`, `input`, `openchange`, `selectionchange`, `pagechange`, `dismiss`). Payloads live on `event.detail`. There is no `onPress` prop.
- **Overlays**: Toggle `is-open` (or `el.isOpen`) on `<moul-modal>`, `<moul-drawer>`, `<moul-alert-dialog>`, `<moul-popover>`, `<moul-tooltip>`, `<moul-hover-card>`, `<moul-command-palette>`, `<moul-notification-bell>`, `<moul-expandable-card>`, `<moul-focus-mode>`, and react to `openchange` (`detail.isOpen`). Start a `<moul-tour>` with `start()`; its `openchange` also carries `detail.isComplete`.
- **Forms**: Inputs are form-associated via `ElementInternals`; give each a `name` and it submits with a native `<form>` / `FormData`. Enter in `<moul-text-field>`, `<moul-number-field>`, or `<moul-search-field>` submits its `<form>` or `<moul-form>` like a native input, so do not add your own Enter handler.
- **Semantic tones & variants**: `tone` is one of `primary | accent | success | warning | error`; surface `variant` is one of `solid | flat | shadow | bordered | glass`. Omit `variant` for a neutral surface: an unset `variant` on `<moul-card>`, `<moul-alert>`, `<moul-toast>`, or `<moul-stat>` renders the plain `--color-surface` look, while `variant="flat"` tints it in the tone. `<moul-button>` has its own `variant` set (`primary | secondary | tertiary | outline | ghost | danger | danger-soft`).
- **Accessibility**: Icon-only buttons (`is-icon`) and dot badges (`is-dot`) must have an `aria-label`.
- **Theming**: Override `--brand-hue`, `--brand-chroma-multiplier`, `--brand-font-family`, `--brand-font-scale`, `--brand-radius-factor`, and `--brand-density-factor` on `:root` (or any ancestor). Style internals through `::part(...)`.

## Context Files

- [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt): Complete attribute, property, event, slot, and CSS part reference for every element.
- [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md): Agent rules, recipes, and anti-patterns.
- [Theme inspector](/theme): Live brand token playground.

## Component Index

### Charts & Data Visualization

- [AreaChart](/docs/components/charts/areachart): Area chart with optional stacking that you scrub with the pointer or arrow keys (slider semantics), and that morphs between data sets such as 7/30/90-day ranges. Elements: `<moul-area-chart>`.

```html
<moul-area-chart id="revenue" label="Revenue" x-key="month" height="280" stacked></moul-area-chart>
```

```js
const chart = document.querySelector('#revenue')
chart.data = [
  { month: 'Jan', web: 120, mobile: 80 },
  { month: 'Feb', web: 160, mobile: 95 },
]
chart.series = [
  { key: 'web', name: 'Web' },
  { key: 'mobile', name: 'Mobile' },
]
```

- [BarChart](/docs/components/charts/barchart): Vertical or horizontal bar chart with grouped or stacked series. Elements: `<moul-bar-chart>`.

```html
<moul-bar-chart id="signups" x-key="day" layout="vertical" show-grid></moul-bar-chart>
```

```js
const chart = document.querySelector('#signups')
chart.data = [{ day: 'Mon', count: 12 }, { day: 'Tue', count: 18 }]
chart.series = [{ key: 'count', name: 'Sign-ups' }]
```

- [LineChart](/docs/components/charts/linechart): Multi-series line chart with pointer and keyboard scrubbing; `is-live` turns it into a real-time feed with `push()`, `max-points`, a gliding line and a pause button. Elements: `<moul-line-chart>`.

```html
<moul-line-chart id="latency" label="Latency" x-key="time" is-live max-points="40"></moul-line-chart>
```

```js
const chart = document.querySelector('#latency')
chart.series = [{ key: 'p50', name: 'p50' }, { key: 'p99', name: 'p99' }]
chart.valueFormatter = (v) => `${v} ms`
setInterval(() => chart.push({ time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(), p50: 40, p99: 160 }), 1000)
```

- [DoughnutChart](/docs/components/charts/doughnutchart): Doughnut, pie or half-circle chart whose centre shows the hovered slice; set `value`/`min`/`max` for a gauge that sweeps and counts to each new value. Elements: `<moul-doughnut-chart>`.

```html
<moul-doughnut-chart id="traffic" center-label="12.4k" center-sublabel="Visits"></moul-doughnut-chart>
<moul-doughnut-chart shape="half" height="170" value="72" center-sublabel="Disk used"></moul-doughnut-chart>
```

```js
document.querySelector('#traffic').data = [
  { name: 'Direct', value: 5400 },
  { name: 'Search', value: 4100 },
  { name: 'Social', value: 2900 },
]
```

- [HeatmapChart](/docs/components/charts/heatmapchart): Contributions-style calendar of daily totals, or a weekday × hour punch card (`mode="hour"`) from the same timestamps. Elements: `<moul-heatmap-chart>`.

```html
<moul-chart-container title="Activity" description="Daily contributions">
  <moul-tabs slot="header" selected-key="calendar">
    <moul-tab key="calendar">Calendar</moul-tab>
    <moul-tab key="hour">By hour</moul-tab>
  </moul-tabs>
  <moul-heatmap-chart id="activity" unit="contributions"></moul-heatmap-chart>
</moul-chart-container>
```

```js
const heatmap = document.querySelector('#activity')
// One item per event (value defaults to 1), or one per day with a total.
heatmap.data = [
  { date: '2025-10-23', value: 6 },
  { date: '2025-10-24T14:05:00', value: 17 },
]
document.querySelector('moul-tabs').addEventListener('selectionchange', (e) => {
  heatmap.mode = e.detail.selectedKey
})
```

- [FunnelChart](/docs/components/charts/funnelchart): Ordered conversion steps as centered bars with per-step drop-off and an overall-conversion summary. Elements: `<moul-funnel-chart>`.

```html
<moul-chart-container title="Signup funnel" description="Visit to paid, last 30 days">
  <moul-funnel-chart id="signups"></moul-funnel-chart>
</moul-chart-container>
```

```js
document.querySelector('#signups').data = [
  { label: 'Visited site', value: 48200 },
  { label: 'Signed up', value: 15840 },
  { label: 'Started paid plan', value: 1380 },
]
```

- [TopList](/docs/components/charts/toplist): Ranked list with proportional value bars. Elements: `<moul-top-list>`.

```html
<moul-top-list id="pages" max-items="5" show-rank interactive></moul-top-list>
```

```js
document.querySelector('#pages').data = [
  { label: '/pricing', value: 1820 },
  { label: '/docs', value: 1240 },
]
```

- [Stat](/docs/components/stat): KPI tile with animated value, trend indicator, and optional sparkline. Elements: `<moul-stat>`.

```html
<moul-stat label="Monthly revenue" value="48210" prefix="$" trend="up" trend-value="+12.5%" tone="success"></moul-stat>
```

- [Percentage](/docs/components/charts/percentage): Linear and circular percentage indicators. Elements: `<moul-percentage-bar>`, `<moul-percentage-circle>`.

```html
<moul-percentage-bar value="72" label="Storage used" tone="warning"></moul-percentage-bar>
<moul-percentage-circle value="64" size="lg" label="Uptime"></moul-percentage-circle>
```

- [ChartContainer](/docs/components/charts/areachart): Chart card with title, description, header actions, legend, and empty state slots; sizes to its chart unless `height` is set. Elements: `<moul-chart-container>`.

```html
<moul-chart-container title="Revenue" description="Last 30 days" height="320">
  <moul-area-chart x-key="month"></moul-area-chart>
  <span slot="empty">No data yet</span>
</moul-chart-container>
```

- [ChartTooltip](/docs/components/charts/areachart): Floating tooltip used internally by charts; usable standalone for custom SVG. Elements: `<moul-chart-tooltip>`.

```html
<moul-chart-tooltip label="Jan" value="$1,200" x="120" y="40" is-open></moul-chart-tooltip>
```

### Actions & Toggles

- [Button](/docs/components/button): Button with 7 variants, 3 sizes, icon-only mode, and pending, success and error states; `run(task)` drives them from a promise. For landing pages: `effect="shimmer|rainbow|neon"` animates the edge, `is-pulsing` adds a pulsing ring, and a `hover` slot swaps in on hover. Elements: `<moul-button>`.

```html
<moul-button variant="primary" size="md">Save changes</moul-button>
<moul-button variant="ghost" is-icon aria-label="Close">×</moul-button>
<moul-button id="save">
  Save
  <span slot="pending">Saving…</span>
  <span slot="success">Saved</span>
</moul-button>
<moul-button size="lg" effect="shimmer" is-pulsing>
  Get started
  <span slot="hover">Read the docs →</span>
</moul-button>
```

```js
const save = document.querySelector('#save')
save.addEventListener('press', () => {
  save.run(() => fetch('/api/save', { method: 'POST' })).catch(() => {})
})
```

- [ButtonGroup](/docs/components/buttongroup): Groups buttons with attached or spaced layouts. Elements: `<moul-button-group>`.

```html
<moul-button-group spacing="none">
  <moul-button variant="outline">Day</moul-button>
  <moul-button variant="outline">Week</moul-button>
</moul-button-group>
```

- [SlideToConfirm](/docs/components/slidetoconfirm): Drag a handle across a track to confirm a risky action; a keyboard slider (arrows, `End`) reaches the same result. Elements: `<moul-slide-to-confirm>`.

```html
<moul-slide-to-confirm tone="error" label="Slide to delete project" confirmed-label="Deleting"></moul-slide-to-confirm>
```

```js
slider.addEventListener('confirm', async () => {
  slider.isPending = true
  try { await deleteProject() } catch { slider.reset() } finally { slider.isPending = false }
})
```

- [SplitButton](/docs/components/splitbutton): Main action joined to a chevron menu of related actions; `press` from the main part, `action` from the menu. Elements: `<moul-split-button>`.

```html
<moul-split-button menu-label="More deploy options">
  Deploy
  <moul-menu-item slot="menu" value="staging">Deploy to staging</moul-menu-item>
  <moul-menu-item slot="menu" value="schedule">Schedule deploy…</moul-menu-item>
</moul-split-button>
```

- [ThemeToggle](/docs/components/themetoggle): Light/dark/system switch with a circular reveal; applies `data-theme` and `color-scheme` to `<html>` and remembers the choice. Elements: `<moul-theme-toggle>`.

```html
<moul-theme-toggle modes="system light dark" variant="ghost"></moul-theme-toggle>
```

- [ToggleButton](/docs/components/togglebutton): Two-state button that reflects `aria-pressed`. Elements: `<moul-toggle-button>`.

```html
<moul-toggle-button value="bold" aria-label="Bold">B</moul-toggle-button>
```

- [ToggleButtonGroup](/docs/components/togglebuttongroup): Single-select toggle group with roving tabindex keyboard navigation. Elements: `<moul-toggle-button-group>`.

```html
<moul-toggle-button-group selected-key="left" aria-label="Alignment">
  <moul-toggle-button value="left">Left</moul-toggle-button>
  <moul-toggle-button value="center">Center</moul-toggle-button>
  <moul-toggle-button value="right">Right</moul-toggle-button>
</moul-toggle-button-group>
```

### Inputs & Forms

- [TextField](/docs/components/textfield): Form-associated text input with label, description, and error message. `placeholders` rotates the placeholder through hints; `vanish()` or `vanish-on-submit` scatters the text away and clears it after its form submits. Elements: `<moul-text-field>`.

```html
<moul-text-field name="email" type="email" label="Email" placeholder="you@example.com" is-required></moul-text-field>
<moul-text-field name="q" label="Search" vanish-on-submit></moul-text-field>
```

```js
document.querySelector('[name="q"]').placeholders = ['Search collections…', 'Find a record…']
```

- [NumberField](/docs/components/numberfield): Numeric input with stepper buttons and min/max bounds. Elements: `<moul-number-field>`.

```html
<moul-number-field name="seats" label="Seats" value="5" min="1" max="50" step="1"></moul-number-field>
```

- [SearchField](/docs/components/searchfield): Search input in a `<search>` landmark with a clear button. `is-expandable` starts it as a round search button that springs open (`--search-field-expanded-width`) and closes when left empty; fires `expandchange`. Elements: `<moul-search-field>`.

```html
<moul-search-field name="q" label="Search" placeholder="Search projects…"></moul-search-field>
<moul-search-field is-expandable label="Search the docs"></moul-search-field>
```

- [TextArea](/docs/components/textarea): Multiline text input with optional content-based auto-resize. Elements: `<moul-text-area>`.

```html
<moul-text-area name="bio" label="Bio" rows="4" auto-resize></moul-text-area>
```

- [Checkbox](/docs/components/checkbox): Form-associated checkbox with indeterminate state. Elements: `<moul-checkbox>`.

```html
<moul-checkbox name="terms" is-required>I accept the terms</moul-checkbox>
```

- [CheckboxGroup](/docs/components/checkboxgroup): Group of checkboxes submitting an array value. Elements: `<moul-checkbox-group>`.

```html
<moul-checkbox-group name="notify" label="Notify me by" orientation="horizontal">
  <moul-checkbox value="email">Email</moul-checkbox>
  <moul-checkbox value="sms">SMS</moul-checkbox>
</moul-checkbox-group>
```

- [RadioGroup](/docs/components/radiogroup): Radio group with arrow-key navigation. Elements: `<moul-radio-group>`, `<moul-radio>`.

```html
<moul-radio-group name="plan" label="Plan" value="pro">
  <moul-radio value="free">Free</moul-radio>
  <moul-radio value="pro">Pro</moul-radio>
</moul-radio-group>
```

- [Switch](/docs/components/switch): On/off switch with `role="switch"` semantics. Elements: `<moul-switch>`.

```html
<moul-switch name="notifications" is-checked>Enable notifications</moul-switch>
```

- [Slider](/docs/components/slider): Range slider with live output. Elements: `<moul-slider>`.

```html
<moul-slider name="volume" label="Volume" min="0" max="100" step="5" value="40"></moul-slider>
```

- [Select](/docs/components/select): Single-select dropdown rendered in a native popover. Elements: `<moul-select>`, `<moul-select-item>`.

```html
<moul-select name="region" label="Region" placeholder="Choose a region">
  <moul-select-item key="us">United States</moul-select-item>
  <moul-select-item key="kh">Cambodia</moul-select-item>
</moul-select>
```

- [ComboBox](/docs/components/combobox): Filterable autocomplete input. Elements: `<moul-combobox>`, `<moul-combobox-item>`.

```html
<moul-combobox name="framework" label="Framework" placeholder="Type to filter…">
  <moul-combobox-item key="astro">Astro</moul-combobox-item>
  <moul-combobox-item key="lit">Lit</moul-combobox-item>
  <span slot="empty">No matches</span>
</moul-combobox>
```

- [DatePicker](/docs/components/datepicker): ISO date input that opens a calendar popover; locale-aware display. Elements: `<moul-date-picker>`.

```html
<moul-date-picker name="start" label="Start date" value="2026-10-19" locale="km-KH"></moul-date-picker>
```

- [FileUpload](/docs/components/fileupload): Drop zone and file list with per-file progress; set `upload` to send each file as it is picked. Elements: `<moul-file-upload>`.

```html
<moul-file-upload name="attachments" label="Attachments" accept="image/*,.pdf" max-size="5242880" is-multiple></moul-file-upload>
```

```js
const field = document.querySelector('moul-file-upload')
field.upload = async (file, { signal, onProgress }) => {
  const body = new FormData()
  body.append('file', file)
  const res = await fetch('/api/files', { method: 'POST', body, signal })
  onProgress(100)
  return res.json() // stored on the item as `response`
}
```

- [Calendar](/docs/components/calendar): Month grid date selector with min/max bounds. Elements: `<moul-calendar>`.

```html
<moul-calendar value="2026-10-19" min-date="2026-01-01" max-date="2026-12-31"></moul-calendar>
```

- [InputOTP](/docs/components/inputotp): One-time passcode input with per-character slots. Elements: `<moul-input-otp>`.

```html
<moul-input-otp name="code" length="6" label="Verification code"></moul-input-otp>
```

- [Form](/docs/components/form): Native `<form>` wrapper that collects values from form-associated `moul-*` fields. Elements: `<moul-form>`.

```html
<moul-form action="/api/signup" method="post">
  <moul-text-field name="email" type="email" label="Email" is-required></moul-text-field>
  <moul-button type="submit">Sign up</moul-button>
</moul-form>
```

### Overlays & Navigation

- [Modal](/docs/components/modal): Native `<dialog>` modal with focus trap and backdrop dismiss. Elements: `<moul-modal>`.

```html
<moul-modal id="invite" size="md">
  <h2 slot="header">Invite teammates</h2>
  <p>Send an invite link to your team.</p>
  <moul-button slot="footer" variant="primary">Send</moul-button>
</moul-modal>
```

```js
document.querySelector('#invite').isOpen = true
```

- [AlertDialog](/docs/components/alertdialog): Blocking confirmation dialog with `role="alertdialog"` and confirm/cancel events. Elements: `<moul-alert-dialog>`.

```html
<moul-alert-dialog is-open tone="error">
  <span slot="header">Delete project?</span>
  <span slot="body">This action cannot be undone.</span>
</moul-alert-dialog>
```

- [Drawer](/docs/components/drawer): Edge-anchored panel built on native `<dialog>`; `is-sheet` makes it a bottom sheet dragged down to dismiss. Elements: `<moul-drawer>`.

```html
<moul-drawer placement="right" size="md" is-open>
  <h2 slot="header">Filters</h2>
  <p>Drawer content</p>
</moul-drawer>
<moul-drawer is-sheet aria-label="Share">
  <h2 slot="header">Share</h2>
  <moul-button slot="footer">Done</moul-button>
</moul-drawer>
```

- [DropdownMenu](/docs/components/dropdownmenu): Menu button: items, checkbox and radio items, groups and separators; fires `action` with `detail.value`. Elements: `<moul-dropdown-menu>`, `<moul-menu-item>`, `<moul-menu-group>`, `<moul-menu-separator>`.

```html
<moul-dropdown-menu placement="bottom-end">
  <moul-button slot="trigger" variant="outline">Actions</moul-button>
  <moul-menu-item value="edit" shortcut="⌘E">Edit</moul-menu-item>
  <moul-menu-group label="Sort by">
    <moul-menu-item type="radio" value="name" is-checked>Name</moul-menu-item>
    <moul-menu-item type="radio" value="date">Date</moul-menu-item>
  </moul-menu-group>
  <moul-menu-separator></moul-menu-separator>
  <moul-menu-item value="delete" variant="danger">Delete</moul-menu-item>
</moul-dropdown-menu>
```

```js
menu.addEventListener('action', (e) => console.log(e.detail.value))
```

- [Stepper](/docs/components/stepper): Multi-step flow with an animated connector; cancel `stepchange` to keep the user on a step that does not validate. Elements: `<moul-stepper>`, `<moul-step>`.

```html
<moul-stepper id="checkout" current="0">
  <moul-step label="Cart" description="3 items">…</moul-step>
  <moul-step label="Delivery">…</moul-step>
  <moul-step label="Payment">…</moul-step>
</moul-stepper>
```

```js
const stepper = document.querySelector('#checkout')
stepper.addEventListener('stepchange', (e) => {
  if (e.detail.current > e.detail.previous && !isValid()) e.preventDefault()
})
stepper.next()
```

- [Tree](/docs/components/tree): Collapsible tree view with roving focus, type-ahead and none/single/multiple selection. Elements: `<moul-tree>`, `<moul-tree-item>`.

```html
<moul-tree label="Project files" selection-mode="single">
  <moul-tree-item value="src" label="src" is-expanded>
    <moul-tree-item value="src/index.ts" label="index.ts"></moul-tree-item>
  </moul-tree-item>
  <moul-tree-item value="docs" label="docs" has-children></moul-tree-item>
</moul-tree>
```

- [Popover](/docs/components/popover): Popover API + CSS anchor positioning with a slotted trigger. Elements: `<moul-popover>`.

```html
<moul-popover placement="bottom">
  <moul-button slot="trigger" variant="outline">Options</moul-button>
  <p>Popover content</p>
</moul-popover>
```

- [Tooltip](/docs/components/tooltip): Hover/focus label that slides out of its trigger; `follow="pointer"` trails the pointer, `is-rich` makes a small non-interactive card with a `media` slot. Elements: `<moul-tooltip>`.

```html
<moul-tooltip content="Copy to clipboard" placement="top">
  <moul-button is-icon aria-label="Copy">⧉</moul-button>
</moul-tooltip>
<moul-tooltip is-rich follow="pointer">
  <moul-avatar name="Sophea Chan" tabindex="0"></moul-avatar>
  <img slot="media" src="/sophea.jpg" alt="" />
  <span slot="content">Sophea Chan · Design</span>
</moul-tooltip>
```

- [HoverCard](/docs/components/hovercard): Preview card beside a link or name on hover or keyboard focus; may hold links and buttons and stays open while the pointer is in it. Touch never opens it. Elements: `<moul-hover-card>`.

```html
<moul-hover-card placement="bottom" open-delay="500" close-delay="300">
  <a slot="trigger" href="/people/sophea">@sophea</a>
  <strong>Sophea Chan</strong>
  <moul-button size="sm" variant="secondary">Follow</moul-button>
</moul-hover-card>
```

```js
card.addEventListener('openchange', (e) => console.log(e.detail.isOpen))
```

- [Notification Bell](/docs/components/notificationbell): Bell button with an unread badge that swings when `count` rises and opens a panel listing its children. Elements: `<moul-notification-bell>`.

```html
<moul-notification-bell id="inbox" count="2">
  <moul-button slot="header-actions" size="sm" variant="ghost">Mark all read</moul-button>
  <div>Deploy finished</div>
  <div>New sign-up</div>
  <a slot="footer" href="/notifications">View all</a>
</moul-notification-bell>
```

```js
const bell = document.querySelector('#inbox')
bell.prepend(item)
bell.count += 1
await bell.removeItem(item)
```

### AI Kit

- [AgentActivity](/docs/components/agentactivity): An AI agent's reasoning steps and tool calls as a live compact timeline with status and timing; a tool call's input and output open as highlighted JSON, and the header sums the run up and folds it away. Elements: `<moul-agent-activity>`.

```html
<moul-agent-activity id="activity" is-live></moul-agent-activity>
```

```js
const activity = document.querySelector('#activity')
activity.push({ id: 'call_1', tool: 'list_records', input: { collection: 'posts' }, status: 'running', startedAt: Date.now() })
activity.push({ id: 'call_1', status: 'done', output: { items: [] }, endedAt: Date.now() })
```

- [Chat](/docs/components/chat): A complete AI chat screen: conversation history sidebar, user bubbles, assistant turns with tool calls, a thinking indicator and streamed Markdown answers, suggestions while empty, and a prompt-input composer. It calls no model itself: listen for `promptsubmit` and feed replies back with `push()`, `pushSteps()`, `appendText()` and `updateMessage()`. Elements: `<moul-chat>`.

```html
<moul-chat id="chat" allow-attachments>
  <span slot="footer">Answers can be wrong. Check important facts.</span>
</moul-chat>
```

```js
const chat = document.querySelector('#chat')
chat.suggestions = ['Which collections are there?']
chat.addEventListener('promptsubmit', async (e) => {
  const reply = crypto.randomUUID()
  chat.push({ id: crypto.randomUUID(), role: 'user', content: e.detail.value }, { id: reply, role: 'assistant', status: 'pending' })
  for await (const part of streamAgent(e.detail.value)) {
    if (part.type === 'tool_call') chat.pushSteps(reply, { id: part.id, tool: part.name, input: part.input, status: 'running' })
    if (part.type === 'tool_result') chat.pushSteps(reply, { id: part.id, output: part.output, status: 'done' })
    if (part.type === 'text') chat.appendText(reply, part.text)
  }
  chat.updateMessage(reply, { status: 'done' })
})
chat.addEventListener('stop', () => controller.abort())
```

- [PromptInput](/docs/components/promptinput): Chat composer: auto-growing textarea where Enter sends (IME-safe, Shift+Enter for a new line), Arrow Up recalls history, a model picker, file attachments by button, paste or drop with optional uploads, rotating placeholder hints, and a send button that becomes Stop while `is-generating`. Elements: `<moul-prompt-input>`.

```html
<moul-prompt-input id="composer" allow-attachments accept="image/*,.pdf"></moul-prompt-input>
```

```js
const composer = document.querySelector('#composer')
composer.models = [{ value: 'sonnet', label: 'Sonnet' }, { value: 'opus', label: 'Opus' }]
composer.placeholders = ['Ask about your collections…', 'Summarise errors…']
composer.addEventListener('promptsubmit', (e) => send(e.detail.value, e.detail.attachments, e.detail.model))
composer.addEventListener('stop', () => controller.abort())
```

- [StreamingResponse](/docs/components/streamingresponse): A model's Markdown answer that reveals smoothly as it streams, with headings, lists, tables, code blocks, `[n]` citations linked to `sources`, and copy, regenerate and feedback actions once done. Rendered as text, never HTML; images become links and only http, https, mailto and relative links are kept. Elements: `<moul-streaming-response>`.

```html
<moul-streaming-response id="answer" is-streaming></moul-streaming-response>
```

```js
const answer = document.querySelector('#answer')
for await (const chunk of stream) answer.appendText(chunk)
answer.isStreaming = false
answer.sources = [{ title: 'Records API', url: 'https://moul.dev/docs/records' }]
```

- [ThinkingIndicator](/docs/components/thinkingindicator): Small canvas particle orb with a shimmering label, in a polite `role="status"`, shown while a model works; change `label` as the work moves on. Elements: `<moul-thinking-indicator>`.


### Landing Kit

```html
</moul-reveal>
```

- [TextEntrance](/docs/components/textentrance): Headline text whose letters, words or lines fade, blur or slide in one after another on entering the viewport; read once, whole, by screen readers. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-text-entrance>`.


- [Typewriter](/docs/components/typewriter): Text that types itself with a blinking cursor, or types a list of `words` in turn, deleting each before the next; Khmer-safe. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-typewriter>`.

```html
<moul-typewriter words='["Build.","Ship.","Repeat."]' is-looping></moul-typewriter>
```

- [WordRotate](/docs/components/wordrotate): One word in a sentence cycles through `words` with a slide, fade, blur or flip while its width glides; pauses on hover, focus and off screen. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-word-rotate>`.

```html
<h1>Ship <moul-word-rotate words='["fast","safe","yours"]'>fast</moul-word-rotate> today</h1>
```

- [Scramble](/docs/components/scramble): Letters scramble through random glyphs, then resolve to the text from start to end, on view, on hover or on `play()`. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-scramble>`.

```html
<moul-scramble trigger="hover">Decrypting…</moul-scramble>
```

- [GradientText](/docs/components/gradienttext): Text painted with a moving gradient, a light sweep (`effect="shine"`) or drifting aurora colours, in CSS only. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-gradient-text>`.

```html
<h2>Everything you need, <moul-gradient-text>nothing you do not</moul-gradient-text></h2>
```

- [Highlight](/docs/components/highlight): A marker band, underline, box or circle drawn behind or around words as they scroll into view, in a semantic `tone`. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-highlight>`.

```html
<p>Plain HTML with <moul-highlight effect="marker" tone="warning">motion built in</moul-highlight>.</p>
```

- [Marquee](/docs/components/marquee): An endless row or column of logos, cards or text; copies are inert and hidden from screen readers, it pauses on focus (and on hover with `pause-on-hover`), and becomes a row you scroll by hand under reduced motion. `scroll-velocity` (a number; the attribute alone means 2) speeds it up with the reader's scroll and runs it backward while they scroll up. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-marquee>`.

```html
<moul-marquee fade-edges pause-on-hover speed="40">
  <img src="/logos/one.svg" alt="One" />
  <img src="/logos/two.svg" alt="Two" />
</moul-marquee>
```

- [BentoGrid](/docs/components/bentogrid): Feature cards in an uneven grid: `col-span` and `row-span` per card, one column on narrow screens, and an action that slides in on hover; `effect="spotlight glare glow"` on a card adds the same light as `<moul-card>`. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-bento-grid>`, `<moul-bento-card>`.

```html
<moul-bento-grid columns="3">
  <moul-bento-card col-span="2">
    <img slot="visual" src="/feature.png" alt="" />
    <h3 slot="heading">Motion as markup</h3>
    Text effects are attributes, not scripts.
    <moul-link slot="action" href="/docs">Learn more →</moul-link>
  </moul-bento-card>
  <moul-bento-card>…</moul-bento-card>
</moul-bento-grid>
```

- [BrowserFrame](/docs/components/browserframe): A browser window mock-up with window dots and an address bar around a screenshot or any content. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-browser-frame>`.

```html
<moul-browser-frame url="example.com">
  <img src="/screenshot.png" alt="The dashboard" />
</moul-browser-frame>
```

- [PhoneFrame](/docs/components/phoneframe): A phone mock-up drawn in CSS around a screenshot or video, `variant="iphone"` or `"android"`, sized by `--phone-frame-width`. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-phone-frame>`.

```html
<moul-phone-frame variant="iphone">
  <img src="/app.png" alt="The app's home screen" />
</moul-phone-frame>
```

- [ScrollProgress](/docs/components/scrollprogress): A thin bar that fills as the page (or the container named by `for`) scrolls, fixed to the top or bottom or in flow; decorative. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-scroll-progress>`.

```html
<moul-scroll-progress></moul-scroll-progress>
```

### Backgrounds & Light

- [Pattern](/docs/components/pattern): A quiet background pattern behind its content: `variant="dots|grid|hexagons|stripes|lines"`, `fade="radial|top|bottom|edges"` to soften it, and `is-animated` to light `count` random cells (grid, dots) or let the pattern drift (the others). Wrap content, or use it empty as a layer. Effects entry; still under reduced motion. Elements: `<moul-pattern>`.

```html
<moul-pattern variant="grid" fade="radial" is-animated count="12">
  <h2>Ship on every push</h2>
  <p>Previews, rollbacks and logs in one place.</p>
</moul-pattern>
```

- [PerspectiveGrid](/docs/components/perspectivegrid): A grid receding into depth behind its content, lines flowing toward the viewer: `variant="floor"` runs back to a horizon (`angle`, default 65), `tunnel` is four walls meeting in the centre. Effects entry; still under reduced motion. Elements: `<moul-perspective-grid>`.

```html
<moul-perspective-grid variant="floor" style="min-height: 24rem">
  <h2>Built for what comes next</h2>
</moul-perspective-grid>
```

- [Ripple](/docs/components/ripple): Concentric rings (`count`, default 6) pulsing outward in sequence behind an icon, avatar or button centred in it, fainter toward the edge. Effects entry; still under reduced motion. Elements: `<moul-ripple>`.

```html
<moul-ripple count="6">
  <moul-avatar name="Sophea Chan" size="lg"></moul-avatar>
</moul-ripple>
```

- [Aurora](/docs/components/aurora): Slow-drifting, blurred colour behind a hero or section: `variant="aurora"` sways bands across the top, `blobs` drifts and reshapes large blobs; colours from `--aurora-color-1` to `-3`. Effects entry; a still field under reduced motion. Elements: `<moul-aurora>`.

```html
<moul-aurora variant="blobs" style="padding: 6rem 2rem">
  <h1>Ship on every push</h1>
  <p>Previews, logs and rollbacks for every branch.</p>
</moul-aurora>
```

- [Noise](/docs/components/noise): A film-grain texture laid over its content (a hero, a card, a gradient) from an SVG turbulence mask in a token colour; `frequency` sets the grain, `is-animated` makes it flicker like film. Effects entry; still under reduced motion. Elements: `<moul-noise>`.

```html
<moul-noise style="border-radius: 1rem">
  <moul-aurora variant="blobs" style="padding: 6rem 2rem; border-radius: inherit">
    <h1>Made by hand</h1>
  </moul-aurora>
</moul-noise>
```

- [LightRays](/docs/components/lightrays): Soft blurred rays (`count`, default 7) fanning down from the top edge, each swaying and brightening at its own pace, behind a hero or a heading. Effects entry; still under reduced motion. Elements: `<moul-light-rays>`.

```html
<moul-light-rays count="9" style="padding: 6rem 2rem">
  <h1>Light where it matters</h1>
</moul-light-rays>
```

- [Spotlight](/docs/components/spotlight): Light falling on a hero from above: `variant="cone"` slides in from a top corner (`placement="start|center|end"`), `lamp` widens a bright line and its cone of light, both once as they enter view (`play()` replays, `is-lit` shows it at once); `sway` swings two lights slowly. Effects entry; end state at once under reduced motion. Elements: `<moul-spotlight>`.

```html
<moul-spotlight variant="lamp" style="padding: 5rem 2rem 4rem; text-align: center">
  <h1>Build under a good light</h1>
</moul-spotlight>
```

- [BorderBeam](/docs/components/borderbeam): Wraps a card or panel and sends a short bright beam round its border, following the rounded corners (the radius is the element's own `border-radius`); `is-reverse` turns it the other way. Effects entry; still under reduced motion. Elements: `<moul-border-beam>`.

```html
<moul-border-beam>
  <moul-card><moul-card-body>Pro: $24 a month</moul-card-body></moul-card>
</moul-border-beam>
```

- [ShineBorder](/docs/components/shineborder): Wraps a card or panel in a thin border whose colours drift slowly round it (`--shine-border-colors`); quieter than a border beam. Effects entry; still under reduced motion. Elements: `<moul-shine-border>`.

```html
<moul-shine-border>
  <moul-card><moul-card-body>Team: $48 a month</moul-card-body></moul-card>
</moul-shine-border>
```

- [Beams](/docs/components/beams): A background of faint SVG lines with light travelling along them, behind a hero or feature section: `variant="beams"` curves from a corner, `lines` waves across, `rain` falls and flashes where it lands. Effects entry; the lines stay and nothing travels under reduced motion. Elements: `<moul-beams>`.

```html
<moul-beams variant="lines" style="padding: 4rem 1.5rem">
  <h2>Ship on every push</h2>
</moul-beams>
```

- [Backlight](/docs/components/backlight): Wraps an image or video and draws a glow behind it in the media's own colours with an SVG filter, so it follows a playing video; `blur` (property `glowBlur`) and `saturation` tune it. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-backlight>`.

```html
<moul-backlight blur="24">
  <img src="/screenshot.png" alt="The editor with a preview panel open" />
</moul-backlight>
```

- [FocusGroup](/docs/components/focusgroup): A grid of tiles where the one under the pointer, or holding keyboard focus, stays sharp while its siblings blur, dim and shrink; suits image-led tiles. Effects entry; no transition under reduced motion. Elements: `<moul-focus-group>`.

```html
<moul-focus-group>
  <a href="/places/angkor"><img src="/angkor.jpg" alt="" /> Angkor Wat at dawn</a>
  <a href="/places/koh-rong"><img src="/koh-rong.jpg" alt="" /> Koh Rong</a>
</moul-focus-group>
```

- [EdgeBlur](/docs/components/edgeblur): A scroll container (give it a height) whose content blurs out progressively toward its edges; `orientation="horizontal"` for a row, `edges="start|end"` for one side. Where scroll timelines exist, an edge clears when there is nothing more to scroll that way. Focusable by keyboard; label it with `aria-label`. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-edge-blur>`.

```html
<moul-edge-blur aria-label="Release notes" style="height: 18rem">
  <ul>…</ul>
</moul-edge-blur>
```

- [Orbit](/docs/components/orbit): Icons, logos or avatars spaced evenly on a ring that turns slowly round a centre, staying upright (`radius`, `duration`, `is-reverse`, `show-path`, `pause-on-hover`; pauses while focus is inside). Nest another orbit in `slot="center"` for more rings. Effects entry; still under reduced motion. Elements: `<moul-orbit>`.

```html
<moul-orbit radius="128" show-path pause-on-hover>
  <img src="/logos/one.svg" alt="One" />
  <img src="/logos/two.svg" alt="Two" />
  <moul-orbit slot="center" radius="64" duration="14" is-reverse>…</moul-orbit>
</moul-orbit>
```

### Navigation & Media

- [Navbar](/docs/components/navbar): Sticky site top bar with `brand`, default (inside a `<nav>` landmark) and `actions` slots plus a `banner` slot above it; `variant="floating"` for an inset pill, `effect="shrink glass"` once scrolled past `threshold`, `hide-on-scroll` slides it away on the way down. Below `collapse-below` px (768) the navigation folds behind a menu button into a panel (`openchange`) and a child `moul-navigation-menu` turns vertical. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-navbar>`.

```html
<moul-navbar variant="floating" effect="glass shrink" hide-on-scroll>
  <moul-banner slot="banner" hide-on-scroll is-dismissable>Moul UI 1.0 is out. <a href="/changelog/">Read the notes</a></moul-banner>
  <a slot="brand" href="/">Moul</a>
  <a href="/docs/" aria-current="page">Docs</a>
  <a href="/examples/">Examples</a>
  <moul-button slot="actions" size="sm">Get started</moul-button>
</moul-navbar>
```

- [Banner](/docs/components/banner): One-line announcement (a `region` landmark) with `tone`, `variant="solid|flat"`, `icon` and `action` slots; `is-dismissable` fires a cancelable `dismiss` and folds it away, `storage-key` remembers that in localStorage; `is-sticky` + `hide-on-scroll` slides it away on the way down, and in a navbar's `banner` slot the navbar slides it. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-banner>`.

```html
<moul-banner tone="primary" is-dismissable storage-key="release-1-0">
  Moul UI 1.0 is out. <a href="/changelog/">Read the notes</a>
  <moul-button slot="action" size="sm" variant="outline">Upgrade</moul-button>
</moul-banner>
```

- [NavigationMenu](/docs/components/navigationmenu): Site navigation whose panels open on hover and morph from one item to the next (one floating surface slides and resizes; content slides in from the side of travel). Items with `href` are plain links; `moul-navigation-menu-link` is a link card with icon, label and description; `orientation="vertical"` stacks items with inline disclosure panels (moul-navbar switches to it when collapsed). Fires `openchange` with `detail.value`. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-navigation-menu>`, `<moul-navigation-menu-item>`, `<moul-navigation-menu-link>`.

```html
<nav aria-label="Main">
  <moul-navigation-menu>
    <moul-navigation-menu-item label="Products" columns="2">
      <moul-navigation-menu-link href="/docs/" label="Components" description="Ninety elements for apps and sites.">
        <svg slot="icon" aria-hidden="true">…</svg>
      </moul-navigation-menu-link>
    </moul-navigation-menu-item>
    <moul-navigation-menu-item label="Pricing" href="/pricing/"></moul-navigation-menu-item>
  </moul-navigation-menu>
</nav>
```

- [Dock](/docs/components/dock): A glass bar of icons that grow under a mouse or pen like a desktop dock (`magnification`, `distance`, `orientation`); items are links (`href`) or buttons with a `label` tooltip and `is-active` dot, separated by `moul-dock-separator`. A toolbar with arrow-key focus. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-dock>`, `<moul-dock-item>`, `<moul-dock-separator>`.

```html
<moul-dock label="Quick links">
  <moul-dock-item label="Home" href="/" is-active><svg aria-hidden="true">…</svg></moul-dock-item>
  <moul-dock-item label="Search"><svg aria-hidden="true">…</svg></moul-dock-item>
  <moul-dock-separator></moul-dock-separator>
  <moul-dock-item label="Settings"><svg aria-hidden="true">…</svg></moul-dock-item>
</moul-dock>
```

- [ProgressNav](/docs/components/progressnav): A floating pill with a scroll-depth ring and the active heading of an article (`for`, `headings`, `placement="bottom|top|inline"`); pressing it opens a nested list of headings to jump to. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-progress-nav>`.

```html
<article id="guide">…<h2>Planning the trip</h2>…</article>
<moul-progress-nav for="guide" headings="h2, h3"></moul-progress-nav>
```

- [Carousel](/docs/components/carousel): A row of slides (every child) the reader drags, swipes or steps through, settling on the nearest slide after a flick; arrows, dots, `align="start|center"`, `is-loop`, and `autoplay="6000"` with a play button that holds on hover, focus, off screen and a hidden tab. `--carousel-slide-size` lets the next slide peek in; `slidechange`, `next()`, `previous()`, `goTo()`. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-carousel>`.

```html
<moul-carousel label="Customer stories" style="--carousel-slide-size: min(20rem, 80%)">
  <moul-card>…</moul-card>
  <moul-card>…</moul-card>
  <moul-card>…</moul-card>
</moul-carousel>
```

- [ImageSlider](/docs/components/imageslider): A full-width slideshow of `<img>` children with a scrim and a `slot="overlay"` for a headline; `effect="fade|slide|zoom"`, autoplay every `interval` ms (default 5000, 0 is off) with a pause button, swipe, arrows, dots and arrow keys; goes round from last to first. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-image-slider>`.

```html
<moul-image-slider label="Mondulkiri in four days" effect="fade">
  <img src="/hills.jpg" alt="Hills in mist at dawn" />
  <img src="/lake.jpg" alt="A crater lake in the forest" />
  <div slot="overlay"><h2>Four days in the hills</h2></div>
</moul-image-slider>
```

- [Compare](/docs/components/compare): Two images in one frame with a draggable divider (`role="slider"`, arrows/Page/Home/End) to compare a before and an after; `position` 0–100, `orientation="vertical"`, `mode="hover"`, optional `before-label`/`after-label` chips; fires `input` and `change` with `detail.position`. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-compare>`.

```html
<moul-compare label="Edited photo" before-label="Before" after-label="After" position="50">
  <img slot="before" src="/photos/raw.jpg" alt="The photo straight from the camera" />
  <img slot="after" src="/photos/edited.jpg" alt="The same photo, warmer and brighter" />
</moul-compare>
```

- [VideoDialog](/docs/components/videodialog): Thumbnail button with a play icon that opens an embed URL (`<iframe>`) or a video file (`<video>`) in a native modal dialog; the player exists only while open. `animation="expand|fade|slide-up"`, `is-open`/`setOpen()`, `openchange`; only http(s) and relative URLs play. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-video-dialog>`.

```html
<moul-video-dialog src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/VIDEO_ID" label="Watch the two-minute tour">
  <img slot="thumbnail" src="/images/tour-poster.jpg" alt="" />
</moul-video-dialog>
```

- [WorldMap](/docs/components/worldmap): A dotted world map drawn from an embedded land mask (no image, request or map library) with pins (`markers`) and curved lines (`arcs`) that draw in turn when it scrolls into view, then carry a travelling light; places are `{ lat, lng, label }`, as properties or JSON attributes, and `show-labels` writes the labels beside the pins. One image to screen readers, named by `label`, plus a hidden list of places and routes. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-world-map>`.

```html
<moul-world-map label="Our offices" show-labels
  arcs='[{ "from": { "lat": 11.56, "lng": 104.92, "label": "Phnom Penh" }, "to": { "lat": 38.72, "lng": -9.14, "label": "Lisbon" } }]'
></moul-world-map>
```

### Pointer & Scroll

- [Tilt](/docs/components/tilt): Wraps a card or image and tilts it in 3D toward a mouse or pen, springing back flat on leave (`max-tilt` degrees, `perspective`, `hover-scale`, `is-reversed`, `glare` for a light that follows the pointer). Parts of a `transform-style: preserve-3d` box can be lifted with `translate: 0 0 2rem`. Flat under reduced motion. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-tilt>`.

```html
<moul-tilt glare max-tilt="12" style="border-radius: 1rem">
  <div class="card" style="border-radius: inherit">…</div>
</moul-tilt>
```

- [Magnetic](/docs/components/magnetic): Wraps one button or link so it drifts toward a mouse or pen within `reach` px (default 40) by `strength` of the distance (0 to 1, default 0.3) and springs back. Writes `--magnetic-x`/`--magnetic-y` so an inner label can follow further. Focus goes to the control; still under reduced motion. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-magnetic>`.

```html
<moul-magnetic strength="0.4" reach="60">
  <moul-button variant="primary">Book a trip</moul-button>
</moul-magnetic>
```

- [GlowBorder](/docs/components/glowborder): Wraps a box (or overlays it when empty) and lights its border on the side nearest a mouse or pen, fading out `proximity` px (64) away; `spread` (degrees, 80) sets the lit arc, `blur` adds a halo, `--glow-border-colors` sets the gradient. Tracks the pointer only while on screen; decorative. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-glow-border>`.

```html
<moul-glow-border proximity="96" spread="100">
  <moul-card><moul-card-body>Pro plan</moul-card-body></moul-card>
</moul-glow-border>
```

- [HoverHighlight](/docs/components/hoverhighlight): One highlight that slides behind a set of items (direct children, or `item-selector`) to the one under the mouse or pen, or with keyboard focus, taking its size and radius; it fades out on leave, or with `is-persistent` rests on the `aria-current`/`data-active` item or the last one. The hovered item gets `data-highlighted`. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-hover-highlight>`.

```html
<moul-hover-highlight is-persistent style="display: flex">
  <a href="/overview" aria-current="page">Overview</a>
  <a href="/getting-there">Getting there</a>
  <a href="/where-to-stay">Where to stay</a>
</moul-hover-highlight>
```

- [DirectionHover](/docs/components/directionhover): A picture whose `overlay` slot slides in from the edge the pointer entered and out toward the edge it left, while the picture zooms slightly; focus inside or a tap shows it from the bottom. State is reported as `data-state` and `data-edge`. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-direction-hover>`.

```html
<moul-direction-hover style="aspect-ratio: 4 / 3">
  <img src="/kep.jpg" alt="The coast at Kep, with fishing boats" />
  <div slot="overlay"><strong>Kep</strong> Crab market and sunsets</div>
</moul-direction-hover>
```

- [Lens](/docs/components/lens): A round magnifier (`size` px, 160) that follows the pointer over an image or any content and shows it `zoom` times larger (2), using an aria-hidden, inert light-DOM copy so page CSS still applies; `is-static` with `position-x`/`position-y` fixes it in place. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-lens>`.

```html
<moul-lens zoom="2.5" size="180">
  <img src="/paddies.jpg" alt="Rice paddies and a stilt house at dusk" />
</moul-lens>
```

- [Cursor](/docs/components/cursor): Replaces the mouse cursor over its content (or the whole page with `scope="page"`) with a smooth follower: `variant="dot"` (dot plus trailing ring), `label` (arrow plus pill showing `label`) or `arrow`. It grows over links and buttons, and any `data-cursor-label` shows beside the pointer. Mouse only; text fields, frames, touch, reduced motion and forced colours keep the system cursor. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-cursor>`.

```html
<moul-cursor variant="label" label="Explore">
  <section class="hero">…</section>
  <img data-cursor-label="View" src="/kep.jpg" alt="The coast at Kep" />
</moul-cursor>
```

- [MaskReveal](/docs/components/maskreveal): Two stacked layers; a circle under the pointer uncovers the `revealed` slot beneath the default slot. The circle grows from `size` (0) to `reveal-size` (240 px) on hover, follows a pressed finger, and `is-revealed` (or focus inside the hidden layer) uncovers it all. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-mask-reveal>`.

```html
<moul-mask-reveal reveal-size="200">
  <img src="/sketch.jpg" alt="Pencil sketch of the paddies" />
  <img slot="revealed" src="/painting.jpg" alt="The same scene painted at dusk" />
</moul-mask-reveal>
```

- [PointerParallax](/docs/components/pointerparallax): Layered children shift with the pointer by their `data-depth` (usually -1 to 1; negative moves the other way) times `strength` px; `scope="page"` follows the pointer anywhere on the page. Layers move by the `translate` property, so position them another way. Still under reduced motion. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-pointer-parallax>`.

```html
<moul-pointer-parallax strength="28" style="height: 18rem; overflow: clip">
  <img data-depth="0.3" src="/far.svg" alt="" />
  <img data-depth="1" src="/near.svg" alt="" />
  <h1 data-depth="-0.3">Mondulkiri</h1>
</moul-pointer-parallax>
```

- [ConnectorBeam](/docs/components/connectorbeam): A line between two elements named by id (`from`, `to`) with a short light running along it, for sources flowing into a hub or a request reaching a server. A layer (`position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1`) inside a `position: relative; isolation: isolate` box; `curvature` bows it, `start-x-offset`/`start-y-offset`/`end-x-offset`/`end-y-offset` move its ends, `is-reversed`, `duration` and `delay` (ms) time the light. Redrawn only on resize; paused off screen; decorative and `aria-hidden`. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-connector-beam>`.

```html
<div style="position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: flex; justify-content: space-between">
  <div id="source">📄</div>
  <div id="hub">M</div>
  <moul-connector-beam from="source" to="hub" curvature="40"></moul-connector-beam>
</div>
```

- [ScrollText](/docs/components/scrolltext): Text whose words light up one by one, from dim (`--scroll-text-dim`) to full, as the reader scrolls; write the text inside it or set `text`. `is-pinned` makes a tall section (`--scroll-text-length`, 250vh) with the text held in the viewport while it lights. One scroll timeline drives every word through CSS; Khmer splits at word boundaries; read once as a sentence. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-scroll-text>`.

```html
<h2><moul-scroll-text>Every change to your data is kept, with who made it and when.</moul-scroll-text></h2>
<moul-scroll-text is-pinned>Ship on Friday. Previews for every branch, logs you can search, and a rollback that takes one click.</moul-scroll-text>
```

- [StickyStack](/docs/components/stickystack): Children (cards or full sections) stick near the top one after another and pile up as the page scrolls, each a `--sticky-stack-step` lower so the earlier ones peek out; covered cards shrink (to `min-scale`, 0.9) and dim (`--sticky-stack-dim`) on a native view timeline with a scroll-listener fallback. Keyboard focus in a covered card scrolls back to it. Under reduced motion they still stack but do not shrink. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-sticky-stack>`.

```html
<moul-sticky-stack min-scale="0.9" style="--sticky-stack-top: 5rem">
  <article class="card">…</article>
  <article class="card">…</article>
  <article class="card">…</article>
</moul-sticky-stack>
```

- [ScrollParallax](/docs/components/scrollparallax): Each child is a track that slides as the element crosses the screen: rows (default) alternate left and right, `orientation="columns"` alternate up and down; `speed` is the travel in px (300) and `data-speed` on a track multiplies it (negative reverses, 0 holds still). Moves by `translate` on a native view timeline; still under reduced motion. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-scroll-parallax>`.

```html
<moul-scroll-parallax speed="360">
  <div class="row">…cards…</div>
  <div class="row">…cards…</div>
  <div class="row" data-speed="0">…</div>
</moul-scroll-parallax>
```

- [StickyScroll](/docs/components/stickyscroll): A walk-through in steps: each `moul-sticky-scroll-item` has text and a `media` slot; text scrolls in one column while a pinned panel shows the active step's media (the last step whose text has reached a line 40% down the screen, even after a jump), crossfading, and fires `stepchange` (`{ current, previous, item }`). Optional `--sticky-scroll-tint` per item, `--sticky-scroll-end-space` for room after the last step; under 600px wide it becomes one column with media above the text. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-sticky-scroll>`, `<moul-sticky-scroll-item>`.

```html
<moul-sticky-scroll style="--sticky-scroll-end-space: 40vh">
  <moul-sticky-scroll-item>
    <h3>Open the app</h3><p>Sign in with your phone number.</p>
    <img slot="media" src="/steps/sign-in.png" alt="The sign-in screen" />
  </moul-sticky-scroll-item>
  <moul-sticky-scroll-item>
    <h3>Choose who gets it</h3><p>Pick a saved contact.</p>
    <img slot="media" src="/steps/contacts.png" alt="Saved contacts" />
  </moul-sticky-scroll-item>
</moul-sticky-scroll>
```

- [TracingBeam](/docs/components/tracingbeam): Wraps an article; a gradient line in the inline-start gutter fills as the reader scrolls through it, with a glowing head and a dot that lights once reading starts. Starts when the article top reaches `--tracing-beam-start` (50% of the view) and fills when its end is in view, so it always completes. Native view timeline where supported, passive scroll fallback elsewhere; follows the nearest scroll container. Decorative. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-tracing-beam>`.

```html
<moul-tracing-beam>
  <h2>Day one: Phnom Penh to Kampot</h2>
  <p>The bus leaves the Central Market at seven…</p>
</moul-tracing-beam>
```

- [ScrollFrame](/docs/components/scrollframe): A screen (`moul-browser-frame`, `moul-phone-frame`, image) that starts tilted back by `tilt` degrees (default 20) and lies flat as it scrolls into view, with a `header` slot that rises into place. Uses a native CSS view timeline where supported, otherwise a scroll fallback that follows the nearest scroll container. Flat under reduced motion. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-scroll-frame>`.

```html
<moul-scroll-frame>
  <h2 slot="header">Every booking, one screen</h2>
  <moul-browser-frame url="trips.example.com/today"><img src="/dashboard.png" alt="The bookings dashboard" /></moul-browser-frame>
</moul-scroll-frame>
```

- [PageTransition](/docs/components/pagetransition): Animated change of page through view transitions: `effect` is `wipe` (a panel of `--page-transition-color` sweeps across), `slide`, `circle` (grows from the click point) or `fade`, over `duration` ms. One per page opts the site in to cross-document transitions (load the effects entry with `blocking="render"` or inline `pageTransitionCss(effect, duration)` in <head>); in SPAs, `start(update, { direction, x, y })` wraps `document.startViewTransition`. Plays in reverse when going back or in RTL. No transition under reduced motion. Renders nothing. Effects entry. Elements: `<moul-page-transition>`.

```html
<moul-page-transition effect="wipe"></moul-page-transition>
```

```js
const transition = document.querySelector('moul-page-transition')
transition.start(() => render(nextView), { direction: 'forward' })
```

### Composite Blocks

- [LogsViewer](/docs/blocks/logs): Virtualized log viewer with level filtering, search, and a log detail drawer. Elements: `<moul-logs-viewer>`, `<moul-logs>`.

```html
<moul-logs-viewer id="viewer" title="Build logs" filter-level="all" max-height="480px"></moul-logs-viewer>

<moul-logs show-timestamps wrap-lines>
2026-10-19T10:00:01Z INFO server started on :8080
2026-10-19T10:00:04Z WARN cache miss ratio 0.42
</moul-logs>
```

```js
document.querySelector('#viewer').logs = [
  { id: 1, timestamp: '2026-10-19T10:00:01Z', level: 'info', message: 'server started' },
]
```

- [Sidebar](/docs/blocks/sidebar): Application shell with collapsible navigation, propagated via `@lit/context`. Elements: `<moul-sidebar>`, `<moul-sidebar-aside>`, `<moul-sidebar-header>`, `<moul-sidebar-brand>`, `<moul-sidebar-group>`, `<moul-sidebar-item>`, `<moul-sidebar-divider>`, `<moul-sidebar-footer>`, `<moul-sidebar-user>`, `<moul-sidebar-main>`.

```html
<moul-sidebar layout="sidebar-framed" selected-key="home">
  <moul-sidebar-aside aria-label="Main navigation" show-collapse-toggle>
    <moul-sidebar-header>
      <moul-sidebar-brand title="Moul" subtitle="Workspace" href="/"></moul-sidebar-brand>
    </moul-sidebar-header>
    <moul-sidebar-group label="General">
      <moul-sidebar-item key="home" href="/" label="Home"></moul-sidebar-item>
      <moul-sidebar-item key="inbox" href="/inbox" label="Inbox" badge="3"></moul-sidebar-item>
    </moul-sidebar-group>
    <moul-sidebar-divider></moul-sidebar-divider>
    <moul-sidebar-footer>
      <moul-sidebar-user name="Sophearak Tha" email="hello@moul.dev"></moul-sidebar-user>
    </moul-sidebar-footer>
  </moul-sidebar-aside>
  <moul-sidebar-main>Page content</moul-sidebar-main>
</moul-sidebar>
```
